description: Governor's Secretariat - Central Province - Appoint the Chairman and Members under authorities for three years. Co-operative Service Commission, Transport Service, Road Development and Regional Economic Development Agency
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains government personnel appointments (Chairman and Members to the Co-operative Service Commission and Transport Service Authority) with named individuals and their basic titles/positions. It does not include any detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas for these appointees, fitting the criteria for a People Gazette (Type 2).
